The datasets of the catalog

Source: R/catalog.R
soil_datasets.Rd

One row per dataset of the Global Soil Data Hub (GET /datasets), with the release mirrored now and its provenance, the licence and the citation of the provider, and the catalog notes. Texts are the provider's own, verbatim: use soil_citations() and soil_licences() for what to cite and under which terms.

Usage

soil_datasets(soil = soil_session())

Arguments

soil

A session; the default session when omitted. Client-side: not sent to the API.

Value

A data frame, one row per dataset: name, title, provider_code, description, support_type, geometry_class, release_code, release_status, the counts feature_count, profile_count, horizon_count, observation_count (double), country_codes (list of character), licence_text, licence_url, licence_source_url, licence_retrieved_on (Date), licence_note, citation_text, citation_source_url, citation_retrieved_on (Date), citation_note, the provenance of the release release_acquired_at, release_released_at (POSIXct, UTC), release_source_url, release_source_version, release_source_doi, release_reconstructed (logical), release_note, retired_row_count (rows whose source left the provider, still served), source_assets (list of data frames: the files kept for the release, asset_role, local_path, source_url, checksum_sha256, byte_size, media_type, source_record_id, source_title, source_version, source_published_on, file_modified_at), notes (list of data frames: key, kind (note, raw_only, citation, licence), source_record_id, source_dataset_name, title, body, details (list), decision), and default_geometry_kind, geometry_available, schema_name. Fields the API adds later are kept as list columns (with a soilhub_contract_warning).

Details

Terms: a dataset is a hub collection of one provider (wosis_points, wise_profiles, soter_profiles, soter_polygons, sotwis_polygons, sotwis_components, sotwis_estimates); a release is one download of it from the provider (release_code, legacy_materialized for the data loaded before the provenance was recorded, then release_reconstructed = TRUE); a source dataset is one record of the provider inside a hub dataset (a SOTER country database, a SOTWIS package), named in the notes by source_record_id (ISRIC data hub record) and source_dataset_name.

Rights: soil:summary.

See also

soil_dataset(), soil_citations(), soil_licences()

Other discovery: soil_api_info(), soil_capabilities(), soil_citations(), soil_code_list(), soil_code_lists(), soil_countries(), soil_country(), soil_dataset(), soil_formats(), soil_ttr_flag_legend(), soil_variable_mappings(), soil_variables()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
ds <- soil_datasets(soil)
ds[, c("name", "release_code", "profile_count", "observation_count")]
ds$notes[[which(ds$name == "sotwis_polygons")]][, c("kind", "title")]
} # }
